_help: Foodidu picks on Amazon: products the owner chose, shown on the Amazon Egypt page ("brand") and, the first four, on the home page under the featured banners, with the affiliate tag. Edit it from the dashboard (إدارة المحتوى > اختيارات أمازون). Each item: asin (the 10-character ID after /dp/ in the product link), name and note in en + ar. Never add prices (Amazon allows only prices that update from Amazon). The section is hidden while items is empty.
